# routeur_default_route (Resource)

The Default route of a workspace: the always-present auto-routing catch-all that handles every request no `routeur_routing_rule` matched. Every workspace has exactly one, created and deleted with the workspace; only its quality bias can change. Creating this resource adopts it, and destroying it sets the quality bias back to `50` and stops managing it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "routeur_workspace" "support" {
  slug = "support"
  name = "Support"
}

# Requests no routing rule matched lean towards cheaper models.
resource "routeur_default_route" "support" {
  workspace_id = routeur_workspace.support.id
  quality_bias = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) Id of the workspace this belongs to (`ws_…`), e.g. `routeur_workspace.example.id`. The `routeur_workspace` data source resolves a slug to its id. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `quality_bias` (Number) 0 (cheapest) to 100 (smartest) for the auto-router. Defaults to `50`, which is neutral; removing the argument sets it back to `50`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `id` (String) Public id of the Default route (`route_…`).
- `name` (String) Display name, fixed by routeur.ai (`Default`).
- `priority` (Number) Evaluation order, set by routeur.ai: `1000` or more, so the Default route always runs after every routing rule.
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned and immutable (`route_default`); traces record a match as `rule:<slug>`.
- `updated_at` (String) When it was last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# id: <workspace_id>
import {
  to = routeur_default_route.support
  id = "ws_3"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <workspace_id>
terraform import routeur_default_route.support ws_3
```
